verdict.overall: Since Sunday the clearest shift is PLTR, NVDA and ZETA all flipping to supportive for the nearest weeks, while TSLA stays opposing across all four expiries and AMAT looks weakest with price down 3.4% but magnets still stuck far above it. Confidence in the supportive names is tempered by earnings landing inside the window for PLTR, ZETA, AMAT, NVDA and APP, plus generally pricey-to-very-pricey options chain-wide; GOOGL and SPY/QQQ stand out as calmer, cheaper-option, range-bound setups.
